However, this can also mean that two-stroke engines wear out faster due to the higher operating temperatures and less efficient lubrication.

Maintenance is another factor. Four-stroke engines generally require less frequent maintenance because of their separate lubrication system. Two-stroke engines need regular oil changes and more careful maintenance to prevent engine damage from improper oil-fuel mixtures.
